description: Chris Lambton is running for MA State Representative to ensure Cape Cod remains a strong, sustainable, and connected community for generations. Rooted in his lifelong commitment to Dennis and the Cape, he believes in protecting our natural resources, supporting local businesses, and making housing attainable for working families. His mission is to bring common-sense leadership, collaboration, and a local voice to Beacon Hill — one that puts the communities of Brewster, Dennis and Yarmouth first.
title: Home | Vote for Chris Lambton | 1st Barnstable
